integrity: Ordinary triangle circumradius (circle may cross the sampling boundary), not minimum enclosing radius or a conditional inside-circle law. Symbolic checks reproduce algebra only; the full theorem requires the geometric proof and independent audit remains unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic only through the order-five coefficient as t tends to zero, for each fixed C² planar convex body of positive curvature; no all-radius CDF, nonsmooth extension, or uniform-in-body error bound.
title: The area–perimeter signature in the small-circumradius law of a random triangle
